sentences.text: The Geneva Conference in Switzerland met from 26 April to 21 July 1954.
Its Indochina sessions discussed ending the fighting in Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia.
The Agreement on the Cessation of Hostilities in Viet-Nam is recorded as done at Geneva on 20 July 1954, and it came into force at 24:00 on 22 July 1954, Geneva time.
The Agreement set a provisional military demarcation line, with a demilitarized zone of no more than 5 km on either side.
The forces of the two parties regrouped on opposite sides.
On 21 July the conference issued a Final Declaration, saying that the line was provisional and not a political or territorial boundary, and foreseeing general elections in July 1956.
The Declaration was not signed by the delegations.
